map.name: fortress-quad
map.description: Four identical corner fortresses, rotated 90 degrees: the map edges close two sides of each base; two owned, destructible wall lines close the others, each with one allied-only door. Each base has 1,200 mineral inside and 2,800 at exposed flank expansions outside. Leave through either door; breach enemy walls or doors to enter. Shared deposits lie between corners and in the center.
